rule_edit.title: Rule Editing
rule_edit.help_rule_name:
[Rule Name]
• Purpose: Set the name of this rule for display and differentiation in the interface
• Example: Sakura Anime, Dimension Anime, etc.
• Requirements: Cannot be empty, recommend using the website's common name
rule_edit.help_base_url:
[Website Domain]
• Function: Specify the domain name of the target website, used for matching and identifying web pages
• Examples: https://www.example.com, https://oneanime.com, etc.
• Note: Main domains and subdomains are supported, do not include the path part
rule_edit.help_logo_url:
[Logo Path]
• Function: Specify the path of the website Logo, used for interface display
• Examples: https://www.example.com/logo.png
rule_edit.help_search_img_selector:
[Search Image Selector]
• Purpose: Locate thumbnail elements on the search results page
• Format: CSS selector syntax, used to extract image links from the list page
• Example: img.thumbnail, .image-box img, [data-src], .cover-image
• Common types: img tags, divs with background images, data attributes, etc.
rule_edit.help_detail_title_selector:
[Detail Title Selector]
• Purpose: Extract title content on the details page
• Format: CSS selector, usually a title tag or title class name
• Example: h1.title, .detail-title, article h1, header h2
• Suggestion: Prioritize elements with high uniqueness and stable structure
rule_edit.help_detail_desc_selector:
[Detail Description Selector]
• Purpose: Extract description or summary information on the details page
• Format: CSS selector, typically a paragraph or description container
• Example: .description, p.summary, .intro-text, .content-brief
• Note: Select elements containing key descriptive information
rule_edit.help_detail_content_selector:
[Detail Content Selector]
• Purpose: Extract core content on the details page
• Format: CSS selector, usually the article body or content container
• Example: .content, article, .detail-content, main div
• Important: This is the key selector for scraping main content, please ensure accuracy
rule_edit.help_enable_rule:
[Enable Rule]
• Purpose: Control whether this rule is effective
• Enabled: Rule will be used, participating in web parsing
• Disabled: Rule will be disabled, not participating in parsing process
• Usage: Convenient for testing and managing multiple rules
rule_edit.help_js_script_config:
[JS Script Configuration]
• Purpose: Independently configure JS scripts for search/detail/player pages
• Priority: Pages with JS scripts will use JSON data returned by JS first
• Not Configured: Pages without JS scripts will still use CSS selectors
• Search Script: Return [{"id":"", "title":"", "coverUrl":"", "type":""}]
• Detail Script: Return {"lines": [{"episodes": ["url1", "url2"]}]}
• Player Script: Return {"videoUrl": "https://..."}
• Usage: Handle special scenarios where video URLs are in JS variables or require async loading

rule_guide.title: Holo Rule Authoring Guide
rule_guide.intro: Holo uses a rule-driven architecture, adapting to different anime websites through JSON configuration. Each rule defines the complete flow of how to search, fetch details, and parse playback URLs.
rule_guide.sub_search_selector_ways: Important: Two Ways to Write searchSelector
rule_guide.fd_name: Rule name, used for display in the interface
rule_guide.fd_use_webview: Whether to use WebView to load
rule_guide.fd_is_pure_js: Whether it is a pure JS rule, default false
rule_guide.fd_search_selector: Selector for the search results list container
rule_guide.fd_item_img_selector: Selector to find the image within an item
rule_guide.fd_item_img_from_src: Whether the image is obtained from the src attribute
rule_guide.fd_item_title_selector: Selector to find the title within an item
rule_guide.fd_item_id_selector: Selector to find the detail page link within an item
rule_guide.fd_item_genre_selector: Selector to find the genre within an item (optional)
rule_guide.fd_line_selector: Selector for the playback route list
rule_guide.fd_episode_selector: Selector to find episode links within a route
rule_guide.fd_episode_reverse: Whether to reverse the episode order
rule_guide.fd_video_element_attr: Attribute on the video element that stores the URL
rule_guide.fd_wait_for_target: Whether to wait for the target element to load completely
rule_guide.logic_search:
1. Each element matched by searchSelector is a search result item (entry)
2. Within each item (entry), use itemIdSelector to find child elements and extract their href attribute as mediaId
3. mediaId will be used to build the detail page URL
rule_guide.logic_detail:
1. Each element matched by lineSelector is a playback route
2. Within each route, use episodeSelector to find <a> tags and extract their href attribute as episodeId
3. episodeId will be used to build the play page URL
rule_guide.logic_player:
1. After loading the play page, first find the video element matched by playerVideoSelector
2. Get the video URL from the videoElementAttribute attribute of the video element
3. If the video element is not found, try to find the iframe matched by embedVideoSelector
4. If videoUrlSubsChar is configured, extract the specified part from the URL

rule_guide.error_same_selector: ❌ Error: searchSelector and itemIdSelector select the same element
rule_guide.js_intro: When CSS selectors cannot obtain data (e.g. video URLs are in JS variables), JS script injection can be used.
rule_guide.priority_text:
• Pages configured with JS scripts: use the JSON data returned by JS first
• Pages without JS scripts: parsed using CSS selectors
rule_guide.pure_js_desc: When isPureJs: true is set, the rule will completely rely on JS scripts to obtain data, and CSS selector parsing will no longer be used.
rule_guide.pure_js_features:
• Automatically enable WebView and JS script features
• Hide all CSS selector input boxes, only show JS script input
• Search, detail, and play pages all obtain data through JS scripts
• Suitable for REST API or pure data interface type websites
rule_guide.encoding_desc: JS scripts are stored in JSON using Base64 encoding to avoid escaping issues.
rule_guide.usage_scenarios:
• Video URL is in a JS variable
• Requires async loading
• Complex parsing logic
• Website provides a REST API interface (pure JS rule)
rule_guide.fd_ph_media_id: Detail page ID (href extracted from search results)
rule_guide.fd_ph_episode_id: Episode ID (href extracted from detail page)
rule_guide.placeholder_note: Note: mediaId and episodeId extract the complete href path, such as /anime/1234 or /play/1234/1.
rule_guide.debug_tips:
1. Use WebView: dynamically rendered pages must set useWebView: true
2. Check selectors: test in the browser console with document.querySelectorAll("your selector")
3. View logs: the app log outputs HTML parsing results and JS execution results
4. Test step by step: first search, then detail, finally play
5. Use JS scripts: when CSS selectors cannot obtain data, try JS script injection
rule_guide.faq_a_empty_search: A: Check whether searchSelector is correct and matches search result items.
rule_guide.faq_q_no_episodes: Q: No episodes on the detail page?
rule_guide.faq_a_no_episodes: A: Check lineSelector and episodeSelector, ensure they match routes and episode links.
rule_guide.faq_q_no_video: Q: Cannot get the video URL on the play page?
rule_guide.faq_a_no_video:
A: 
• Check whether playerVideoSelector and videoElementAttribute are correct
• If the video is in an iframe, configure embedVideoSelector
• If the video URL is in a JS variable, use playerScript injection
rule_guide.faq_a_js_empty:
A: 
• Ensure the JS variable has been loaded (may need to wait for async loading)
• Check whether the JS variable name is correct
• Manually execute the JS script in the browser console
